summary: U.S. Navy strikes hit IRGC Navy positions on Qeshm Island near the Strait of Hormuz, prompting IRGC Aerospace Force retaliation with two ballistic missiles at Jordan's Mafraq Al-Salti airbase. Yemeni Armed Forces conducted qualitative operations targeting Riyadh and Aramco's Yanbu facility with ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and drones after 1,018 Saudi airstrikes. Saudi air defenses intercepted six Houthi ballistic missiles aimed at Taif and Yanbu.

sections.executive_summary: U.S. Navy strikes on IRGC Navy positions at Qeshm Island triggered Iranian ballistic missile retaliation against a Jordanian airbase, marking direct U.S.-Iran kinetic exchange. Yemeni forces struck Riyadh and Aramco's Yanbu facility with missiles and drones after over 1,000 Saudi airstrikes, while Saudi defenses intercepted six Houthi ballistic missiles. Israeli operations continue in the West Bank and Gaza border zone amid French military deployment to Saudi Arabia.

sections.threat_assessment: Direct U.S.-Iran kinetic exchange in the Strait of Hormuz raises immediate escalation risks, particularly with IRGC missile strikes on a Jordanian base hosting U.S. forces. The Yemen-Saudi conflict has intensified to a new threshold with mass Saudi airstrikes (1,018) and precise Yemeni retaliation on strategic Saudi depth targets (Riyadh, Yanbu). Houthi threats to close Bab al-Mandab to U.S. shipping and attack U.S. interests create a maritime choke point crisis. French military deployment to Yanbu signals Western commitment to Saudi energy security but expands foreign military footprint. Israeli operations in the West Bank and Gaza border zone continue amid diplomatic isolation over genocide allegations.
sections.regional_response: Jordan hosts Iranian missile strikes on its territory (Mafraq Al-Salti) while its foreign minister engages Iran's top diplomat at UNGA, reflecting complex balancing. Saudi Arabia relies on air defense intercepts and French military reinforcement to protect critical oil infrastructure at Yanbu. Iraq complies with flight suspensions to Iran, indicating sensitivity to U.S.-Iran tensions. Lebanon's new government seeks diplomatic reset with Iran while Israeli drones operate over Beirut. Yemen's threat to close Bab al-Mandab to U.S. vessels directly challenges freedom of navigation and could draw broader naval coalition responses.
sections.intelligence_notes: Movement of four F-15E Strike Eagles from CENTCOM to RAF Mildenhall (Coronet East 117) with six more at Sigonella and up to 13 remaining in theater suggests U.S. force posture adjustments after March loss of one F-15E to Kuwaiti fire. THAAD battery relocation from Gulf to Israel per Carlson report indicates prioritized Israeli missile defense. Iranian oil tankers transiting Atlantic to U.S. under seizure orders reflect ongoing sanctions enforcement. Netanyahu's specific quantitative claims (1M vaccines, 2M tons food) serve as evidence in genocide defense narrative. Macron's Yanbu deployment announcement includes operational details (radars, troops, defensive weapons, Rafales) suggesting advanced planning.
